robots_note: Drupal robots.txt does not disallow /data/api/. API responses carry x-robots-tag noindex (search indexing only, not access). No auth.
notes: NO national DCAT-AP RDF feed: all /catalog.* and dataset .rdf/.ttl paths 404; package_show_rdf returns 400. The donl-rdf extension exposes no public serialisation. Harvest is CKAN JSON only via the non-standard /data/api/3/action/ prefix. license_id is a URI from the DCAT-AP-DONL value list (waardelijsten.dcat-ap-donl.nl); count http://standaarden.overheid.nl/owms/terms/licentieonbekend and empty as unlicensed. Conformance metrics (Q16/Q17/Q18) require synthesising DCAT-AP RDF from this JSON. data.europa.eu not used.
